meta_description: LS Plumbing Southampton offers expert plumbing services across the city. Fast response, honest pricing, and quality guaranteed. Call today for a free quote.
hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured Plumber — Rapid Response Southampton
hero_subhead: Leaks, boilers, or blocked drains — LS Plumbing gets to you fast with honest pricing and no nasty surprises.
services_subhead: From emergency leak repairs to full bathroom installations, LS Plumbing covers every plumbing need for homeowners and landlords across Southampton.

services.title: Emergency Leak Repairs
services.desc: A sudden leak can cause serious damage fast. LS Plumbing offers prompt same-day response across Southampton to stop leaks in their tracks and protect your home.

services.title: Boiler Servicing & Repairs
services.desc: Keep your boiler running safely and efficiently with an annual service or swift repair. We work on all major boiler brands and can advise on replacements when needed.

services.title: Bathroom Installations
services.desc: From a simple shower upgrade to a full bathroom refit, we handle all plumbing pipework and fixtures to a high standard with minimum disruption to your home.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Toilets
services.desc: Stubborn blockages cleared quickly using professional tools and techniques. We diagnose the root cause to prevent the same problem recurring.

services.title: Central Heating
services.desc: Whether you need a radiator replaced, a system power flush, or a full central heating installation, we ensure your home stays warm and your energy bills stay down.

services.title: Pipe & Tap Repairs
services.desc: Dripping taps and worn pipework waste water and money. We repair and replace pipework, taps, and valves throughout Southampton to restore full flow and prevent future issues.

about_pullquote: Every job gets the same care, whether it's a washer or a full refit.
about_para_1: LS Plumbing was founded in Southampton with a straightforward aim: to provide reliable, high-quality plumbing to local homeowners without the inflated call-out fees or vague estimates. With over a decade of hands-on experience, we have built a trusted name across the city.
about_para_2: What sets us apart is our commitment to turning up on time, communicating clearly, and leaving every job cleaner than we found it. Our customers return to us year after year because they know they'll always receive honest advice and first-class workmanship.
reviews_heading: What Southampton Homeowners Say About LS Plumbing

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Called LS Plumbing in the morning about a burst pipe and they were with me within a couple of hours. Professional, tidy, and very fairly priced. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: James T.

reviews.text: Had a boiler issue in the middle of winter and LS Plumbing came out same day. The engineer explained exactly what was wrong and fixed it quickly. Great communication and no hidden charges. Really impressed.
reviews.author: Karen W.

reviews.text: Used LS Plumbing to fit a new bathroom and the standard of work was excellent. Everything was completed on time and within budget. The whole experience was stress-free and the results look fantastic.
reviews.author: David H.
